reason: My POS vendor already runs my orders and I trust them. A QR ordering app that is not linked to the POS means my staff still ring everything up twice, and I do not have the time to set that up.
objection: Setting it up and training staff takes time I don't have, and until direct POS links exist I would be double-entering orders.
would_change_my_mind: My POS vendor adding QR table ordering, or Sora doing the set-up and staff training on site in one visit with a direct POS link ready to go.
